{{Top|leg}}
[[File:ChariotLAV2-FF100.png|thumb|right|300px|The LAVr QH-7 Chariot was a light assault vehicle.]]
'''Light assault vehicles''', also known as '''LAVs''', were small military [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] used from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to at least the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle/Legends|Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle]], or ULAV, was designed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], and was used by a variety of governments, and [[Uulshos Manufacturing/Legends|Uulshos Manufacturing]] produced the [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]], which was used by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] mainly to protect important command personal. By [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], a space-capable light assault vehicle by Uulshos existed, with ''[[Chandrila Skies]]'' being one such vessel.
